title: State Enter
description: Emitted when the FSM enters a state.

run_id.description: Run-scoped identity, stable across a run (including pause/resume). Not required: only FSMExecutor._emit()-routed events stamp it today (ENH-3345); parallel.*/issue.* emitters don't yet (ENH-3346).

loop.description: Loop name, stamped on every FSMExecutor._emit()-routed event (ENH-3345). Not required for the same reason as run_id.

iteration.description: Step count (1-based); increments on every state entry

iteration_count.description: Full-pass (maintain-mode) restart count (0-based); 0 for loops without maintain

flushed.description: Present and true only when the executor flushed a pending shell-action state before honoring a wall-clock timeout (BUG-1226).
